column1: # Frozen decision contract for the struktura CLI calls the live lab daemon makes.
#   name  argv  expected  assert  mode  note
# argv:     whitespace-split; @FIX@ = contract/fixtures, @OUT@ = a fresh temp dir (also the cwd).
#           ` ;; ` runs a second command in the same @OUT@ (idempotence checks).
# expected: file in contract/expected/ (stdout + stderr + exit code + every file left in @OUT@).
# assert:   jq expression, run as `jq -s -e` over the JSON-object lines of stdout ("-" = none).
# mode:     pass  = diff and assertion must hold;
#           xfail = known violation: diff must hold, assertion must FAIL (if it starts to hold,
#                   the case fails so the contract is updated on purpose, not silently).
# PROTECT: pulse decides rollbacks (exit 1 = latest deploy slower).
